myInqPrep: Komwe mukupitako mukalumikizidwa, mudzatha kuwona mauthenga anu otumizidwa ndi mayankho pano.
r1c: Dinani malo opanda kanthu kuti muyike chidutswa. Chakuda ndi Choyera zimasinthana kuyika mpaka zidutswa zonse zili pa bolodi. Chakuda chimayenda choyamba.
r1c2: Momwe mungasewerere: ingodinani malo opanda kanthu komwe muvi woyera ukupita.
r2c: Zidutswa zanu zitatu zikamayikidwa pamzere, ndiye mphero, ndipo mutha kutenga chimodzi mwa zidutswa za mdani wanu.
r2c2: Momwe mungasewerere: mukapanga mphero, dinani chidutswa cha mdani wanu chomwe mukufuna kutenga.
r2c3: Chidutswa mkati mwa mphero sichingatengedwe, pokhapokha zidutswa zonse za mdani wanu zili m'mphero; ndiye mutha kutenga chimodzi kuchokera ku mphero.
r3c: Zidutswa zonse zikayikidwa, yendetsani chidutswa pamzere kupita ku malo opanda kanthu apafupi. Zidutswa zomwe zingasunthe zimapeza mphete yamtundu womwe umaonekera bwino kumbuyo. Dinani chidutswa ndipo komwe chikupita kumawala.
r3c2: Momwe mungasewerere: dinani chidutswa chomwe mukufuna kusuntha, kenako dinani malo oyandikana nawo owala.
r4t: ④ Kutsika mpaka zitatu? Mutha kuuluka
r4c: Mukakhala ndi zidutswa zitatu zokha, mutha kuuluka kupita kumalo opanda kanthu, ngakhale palibe mzere wozilumikiza.
r4c2: Momwe mungasewerere: dinani chidutswa chanu, kenako dinani malo opanda kanthu omwe mukufuna kuuluka.
r5c: Mumapambana pochepetsa mdani wanu kukhala zidutswa ziwiri, kapena powasiya opanda chochita chovomerezeka.
r6c: Wosewera aliyense ali ndi zidutswa 12 ndipo mizere inayi yopingasa imawonjezedwa. Mutha kusuntha mopingasa, ndipo zitatu motsatizana pa diagonal zimapanganso mphero.
r6c2: Momwe mungasewerere: mayendedwe opingasa amagwira ntchito mofananamo — dinani chidutswacho, kenako malo opita.
r6c3: Ngati bolodi ladzaza kwathunthu panthawi yoyika, wosewera woti asunthe sangasunthe ndipo amataya.
r7c: Masewerawa amajambulidwa okha pazochitika zilizonse pansipa. Palibe batani lopereka kujambula.
r7c2: · Malo omwewo a bolodi ndi wosewera yemweyo kuti asunthe amachitika katatu
r7c3: · Mayendedwe 50 (osewera onse awiri pamodzi) amadutsa popanda mphero
r7c4: · Mtundu wa zidutswa 12 zokha: pomwe wosewera ali ndi zidutswa zitatu, mayendedwe 10 (ophatikizidwa) amadutsa popanda aliyense wogwira
r8c: Ngakhale kusuntha kamodzi kumapanga mphero ziwiri nthawi imodzi, mumatengabe chidutswa chimodzi chokha.
r8c2: Mtundu wa zidutswa 9: mutha kuswa mphero ndikutsekanso pakasuntha kwanu kotsatira; nthawi iliyonse mukatseka, mumatenga chidutswa.
r8c3: Mtundu wa zidutswa 12: mphero yomwe mudaswa singapangidwenso pakasuntha kwanu kotsatira; dikirani kusuntha kamodzi. Mayendedwe omwe sapanga mphero ndi abwino.
r8c4: Masewera apaintaneti ali ndi mayendedwe atatu: Wamba ndi masekondi 30 pa kusuntha kulikonse, Wosachedwa ndi mphindi 2, ndipo Kalata ndi maola 24. Mu masewera a Slow and Letter, kusuntha kumachitika zokha nthawi ikatha.

titlesPrep: Mitu idzawonekera seva yapaintaneti ikalumikizidwa. Mayina ndi zikhalidwe za mitu yomwe mumapeza zidzawonetsedwa momwe seva imabwezera. Sikokonzeka.
